chunks: With a broken chain of narration, narrated by Abū Jaʿfar al-Aḥwal, who mentioned it from one who narrated it from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Allah made wudu (ablution) obligatory once for each act, and the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله prescribed for the people twice for each act.

key_terms.الْوُضُوءَ: wudu (ablution), the ritual washing before salat (prayer)
key_terms.بِإِسْنَادٍ مُنْقَطِعٍ: with a broken chain of narration

ai.seo_question: Is wudu (ablution) obligatory once for each part or twice according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Allah obligated the acts of wudu (ablution) once each, while the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله established performing them twice each for the people. It relates to the legal description of ritual purity and the Prophetic sunnah (prophetic tradition) in the practice of wudu (ablution).
